- `AuthFailure`: auth — Check SecretId/Key and CAM policy
- `InvalidParameter`: param — Verify all required parameters are present and valid
- `InvalidCredential`: auth — SecretKey may be expired or invalid
- `ResourceNotFound`: state — Resource may have been deleted; verify existence first
- `UnsupportedOperation`: api — Operation not supported in this region or for this resource type
- `RequestLimitExceeded`: rate_limit — Reduce request frequency; implement exponential backoff
- `InternalError`: unknown — Retry with exponential backoff; if persists, contact support
- `ResourceInsufficient`: quota — Check account quota; request increase if needed
- `DryRunOperation`: dry_run — Dry run passed; operation is safe to execute
